about_the_game:
I was made for this!

Your friend has an old bus and needs your help with fixing it. In the Demo of Bus Flipper Simulator, you will learn renovation basics on three different buses: the 1986 Fleetwood Bounder, the Nissan Diesel Spacerunner, and an American School Bus.

What You’ll Do

  • Clean and Repair
    Remove dirt, break old parts, and make the bus look new.

  • Listen to Customers
    Each customer has different wishes. Can you make a café, a motorhome, or something else special?

  • Earn Rewards
    Finish tasks well and earn money.

  • Construction
    Install partitions, plumbing, and electrical systems with precision.

  • Interactive Elements
    Play with TVs, radios, armchairs, and more to make each space feel alive.

  • Customization
    Choose from a vast palette of materials, colors, and unique design elements.

  • Surface Finishes
    Lay tiles, planks, or panels for a polished look.

  • Quest System
    Tackle side-quests to earn extra rewards and experience.

Demo Missions

  • Fleetwood Bounder – Deep cleaning and sanitizing the inside.

  • Nissan Diesel Spacerunner – Buy new items, sell old ones, then clean up.

  • Fleetwood Bounder – Plumbing installation, laying tiles, arranging and assembling furniture.

  • American School Bus – Electrical work and arranging furniture.

  • Nissan Diesel Spacerunner (From Scratch) – Start with an empty shell and build everything yourself.

Skill Progression

Level up your renovation abilities and unlock advanced tools.

⠀

short_description: Have you ever wondered “What if I buy an old bus and convert it into a camper? Or maybe a cafe on wheels?”. This bus conversion simulator will give you that! You will get a variety of different buses and vans to convert. Clean, destroy, create, customize, test it, sell and make profit!

English*, Russian
